label: Summary statistics
description: Summary statistics (n, mean, SD, median, quartiles, min, max ...) of numeric variables.

label: Counts and percents
description: Counts and percents of each level of categorical variables.

label: Count of one level
description: Counts and percents of one level of each variable (Y, a grade, TRUE).

label: Missing counts
description: Numbers of missing and non-missing values.

label: Number of rows
description: Number of rows (records) of the data, by group.

label: Number of subjects
description: Total number of rows of the data (the subjects of a subject-level data set).

label: Variable labels
description: The label attribute of each variable (to print a variable's own label).

label: Nested subject counts
description: Subjects with an event at each level of a hierarchy (SOC / PT), with any-event and overall rows.

label: Nested event counts
description: Events (records, not subjects) at each level of a hierarchy, with overall rows.

label: Nested subject counts (one level)
description: Subject rates of the innermost level of a hierarchy; ard_stack_hierarchical() is the usual entry.

label: Nested event counts (one level)
description: Event counts of the innermost level of a hierarchy; ard_stack_hierarchical_count() is the usual entry.

label: Worst level per subject
description: Counts of the maximum (worst) level per subject, e.g. the worst toxicity grade.

label: Abnormal values
description: Subjects with an abnormal post-baseline value (Low, High), with or without a normal baseline.

label: Proportion with CI
description: Confidence interval of a proportion (Wilson, Clopper-Pearson, Wald, ...).

label: Mean with CI
description: Confidence interval of a mean (t) or a median.

label: Incidence rate
description: Events per person-time, with a confidence interval.

label: t test
description: Two-sample t test between the two by groups.

label: Wilcoxon rank-sum test
description: Wilcoxon rank-sum (Mann-Whitney) test between the two by groups.

label: Chi-square test
description: Pearson's chi-square test of a variable by the groups.

label: Fisher's exact test
description: Fisher's exact test of a variable by the groups.

label: Test of two proportions
description: Two-sample test of proportions (prop.test()).

label: Poisson test
description: Exact test of a Poisson rate or the ratio of two rates.

label: Mood test of scale
description: Mood two-sample test of scale.

category: Tests: three or more groups / strata
label: Analysis of variance
description: One-way or multi-way ANOVA from a formula (aov()).

category: Tests: three or more groups / strata
label: One-way test of means
description: Test of equal means in a one-way layout (oneway.test()).

category: Tests: three or more groups / strata
label: Kruskal-Wallis test
description: Kruskal-Wallis rank-sum test across the by groups.

category: Tests: three or more groups / strata
label: Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test
description: CMH chi-square test of a variable by the groups within strata.

category: Tests: three or more groups / strata
label: ANOVA of nested models
description: ANOVA comparing a list of models (formulas) fitted to the data.

label: Paired t test
description: Paired t test between two by groups (the subject key pairs the records).

label: Wilcoxon signed-rank test
description: Paired Wilcoxon test between two by groups.

label: McNemar's test
description: McNemar's test of a paired binary variable (one record per subject).

label: McNemar's test (long data)
description: McNemar's test with one record per subject and visit.

label: One-sample t test
description: One-sample t test of a mean.

label: One-sample Wilcoxon test
description: One-sample Wilcoxon signed-rank test.

label: Cohen's d
description: Standardised mean difference (Cohen's d) between two groups.

label: Hedges' g
description: Standardised mean difference (Hedges' g) between two groups.

label: Paired Cohen's d
description: Cohen's d for paired data.

label: Paired Hedges' g
description: Hedges' g for paired data.

label: Standardised mean difference
description: Standardised mean difference (smd package) with an optional CI.

label: Regression model
description: Coefficients of a regression model (lm, glm, coxph ...) from a formula.

label: Regression model (basic)
description: A simpler table of a regression model's coefficients.

label: Least-squares means
description: LS means from a model (emmeans).

label: Least-squares mean differences
description: Differences of LS means between groups (emmeans).

label: ANOVA of a model (car)
description: Type II / III ANOVA of a fitted model (car::Anova()).

label: Variance inflation factors
description: VIF of a fitted model (car::vif()).

label: Wald test of a model
description: Wald test of a fitted model's coefficients (aod).

label: Kaplan-Meier estimates
description: Survival at times, or survival quantiles (median), from a Kaplan-Meier fit.

label: Difference in survival
description: Difference in Kaplan-Meier survival between groups at times.

label: Log-rank test
description: Log-rank (and G-rho family) test of survival curves.

label: Several analyses on the same data
description: Runs several analyses with the same data and by variables; adds the by variable's counts and the total N.

label: Within each subgroup
description: Runs an analysis within each level of the strata (and by) variables.

label: Each pair of groups
description: Runs an analysis for each pair of levels of a variable (pairwise comparisons).

label: Summary with your own function
description: Statistics computed by your own function, which may use other columns of the data.

label: Statistics already computed
description: Turns statistics computed elsewhere (a named list) into an ARD.

label: Argument values
description: Records a function's argument values as an ARD (a building block for writing your own ARD function, not an analysis).

label: Survey chi-square test
description: Chi-square test on a survey design object (not a data frame).

label: Survey rank test
description: Rank test on a survey design object (not a data frame).

label: Survey t test
description: t test on a survey design object (not a data frame).

label: Summary statistics (old name)
description: Old name of ard_summary().

label: Counts and percents (old name)
description: Old name of ard_tabulate().

label: Count of one level (old name)
description: Old name of ard_tabulate_value().

label: Summary with your own function (old name)
description: Old name of ard_mvsummary().

label: Worst level per subject (old name)
description: Old name of ard_tabulate_max().

label: Least-squares mean differences (old name)
description: Old name of ard_emmeans_contrast().
